headline: Orient Electric shares rally after strong second-quarter results
hook: Thirty percent surge in two weeks

Retail investors tracking consumer electrical stocks should note the earnings momentum and analyst targets.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings drive sharp short-term gains in consumer electricals.
